title: chore(console): move the objectui pin cd14d8eeffe1 → 0d12e95361b2, past objectui#13326, so a non-admin approver sees the approval request page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuWZuY6ULhRUicdkMU9wSQGt)_

Fixes #25228
Refs #25227
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This PR moves the console pin from `cd14d8eeffe1` to `0d12e95361b2`: objectui `main` at `0d12e95361b20b1eb9012f97d2d36e5fa7f14374`, the squash merge of objectstack-ai/objectui#13326 (objectui#13324). With it, a non-admin approver who opens a request from the account app's Approvals inbox gets the whole request page again, where the current pin gives them a blank one (the one FAIL of the 18.1.0 pre-release P0 run #25227, `approvals.account-app-entry` acceptance[3]).

The maintainer's decision on #25228 (2026-10-22) was to fix this in objectui and then move the pin, with no pin rollback. This PR is that pin move, plus the re-run of the failed clause on it.

Branch name: the harness assigned `claude/project-thread-8uph7b`, not the repo's `claude/issue-25228-…` convention. No other open PR moves `.objectui-sha`.

## The diff

It changes the same four files as the precedent pin move #25193. The repo's own tooling wrote each one; none was edited by hand.

- `.objectui-sha` and `.changeset/console-0d12e95361b2.md`: `OBJECTUI_ROOT=/home/claude/objectui OBJECTUI_NO_DEEPEN=1 bash scripts/bump-objectui.sh 0d12e95361b20b1eb9012f97d2d36e5fa7f14374 --no-commit`, exit 0. It printed "cd14d8eeffe1..0d12e95361b2 walks completely", "2 releasing changeset(s), 0 breaking", "objectui declared `minor`, recorded as `patch`" and "(on origin/main)".
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`: `pnpm objectui:build`, then `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, exit 0. It reported 107 components and sha256 `d1fde278ffd6…`, the same as at the old pin. So the tracked `sdui.manifest.json` is byte-identical, and only its provenance record moves.
- `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`: `OBJECTUI_ROOT=.cache/objectui-0d12e95361b2 pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep`. It reported "214 region line(s), blob 0131f27cf86d, 25 diagnostic code(s)". Only `rev`, `revDate` and `recordedAgainstPin` changed.

## The changeset

`scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs` derived it from the changesets objectui added over the range. Under ruling A (#25105) a console refresh is `patch` with `Metadata-protocol: none`, whatever level objectui declared. objectui declared `minor` here (the new `ServerReadScope` export of `@object-ui/permissions`), and the digest recorded `patch`.

The range holds five objectui commits: objectui#13326 (this fix), objectui#13318 (Setup → Datasources offers "Sync objects" only on a datasource that can be synced), one release-nothing changeset, and two commits with no changeset (objectui#13325, a pin-script fix, and objectui#13320, a hook port). The changeset body lists both of those by subject.

## Choosing the pin

`0d12e9536` is objectui `origin/main`'s tip, and `cd14d8eeffe1` is its ancestor. objectui CI on `0d12e9536`, read when this PR was opened: merge-group runs CI 39817030030, Lint 39817030092, Repo Gates 39817030141, Changeset Presence 39817029972 and Governed Surface Guard 39817030249 are all `success`. Push runs Lint, Repo Gates, Changeset Guard, Changeset Release and Bundle Analysis are `success`; push `CI` 39818889881 was still `in_progress`.

## Re-test of `approvals.account-app-entry` acceptance[3] on this pin

Run on this branch's head, with the framework built at `8010b641` (`pnpm build --concurrency=2`, all tasks green) and the console built at the pin (`packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` = `0d12e95361b20b1eb9012f97d2d36e5fa7f14374`). Stock `examples/app-showcase` booted on its own port and file DB with `--seed-admin`. Headless Chromium 141 drove it.

- Fixture (#25227's reproduction rule): as admin, invite-member, then sign-up of a new persona, with positions `contributor` and `finance` in the default organization. As the persona, it created an invoice it owns (`owner` = its email) and PATCHed it to `status: sent` + `issued_on`, which launched a new `showcase_invoice_signoff` request. `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id` as the persona answered `viewer.can_act: true`, with the persona in `pending_approvers` and `decision_progress` 0 of 3.
- Signed in through the console form; `get-session` reads the persona. `GET /api/v1/meta/app` lists `showcase_app` and `account`, and not `setup`.
- Account app › Inbox › Approvals lands on `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/component/approvals/inbox`. It shows the tabs My Pending (1) / Submitted by me / All, the request row and the keyboard hint bar. The row's record link is `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/showcase_invoice/record/:invoiceId`.
- Clicking the row opens `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/sys_approval_request/record/:id`. **The page renders:** heading "Invoice Dual Sign-off (parallel approval)", the invoice fields, "Approvals — 0 of 3", the waiting-on chips, and Approve / Reject / Reassign / Send back / Request info / Send reminder / Recall / Reply. Its approval reads all answered 200: `GET /approvals/requests/:id`, `GET /approvals/requests/:id/actions`.
- Approve with a comment: `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/approve` answered 200. The page now reads "Approvals — 1 of 3", the persona is gone from waiting-on, the approver actions are gone (the submitter's Send reminder / Recall / Reply remain), and the Timeline tab lists 2 rows: Submit, then Approve with the comment. The API afterwards: `viewer.can_act: false`, the persona dropped from `pending_approvers`, `decision_progress` 1 of 3, and `/actions` = submit + approve.
- The built entry chunk carries the registration: `packages/console/dist/assets/index-CZNOr-H7.js` contains ``ps({ref:`approvals:inbox`,label:`Approvals Inbox`,…``.

**Verdict: PASS**, measured against what the page serves. One clause phrase does not apply to the served page: "replaces the action bar with the can_act=false explanation". The served request page has no separate "you can no longer act" sentence for any viewer; its declaration carries no such element. The side drawer that had one was retired in objectui#12484. This is a checklist-accuracy note for the item, not a defect of this pin.

## Out of scope

- No objectui source changed here, and nothing was written to objectui.
- No product code, `.github/workflows/**`, `scripts/build-console.sh` or `content/docs/releases/` is in the diff. This PR is not a release act and does not touch the Version Packages PR.
- #25227 (the run record) stays open; its closure follows this PR's merge.
